name: supervision
description: We write your reusable computer vision tools. 💜
one_liner: A toolbox of ready-made building blocks for counting, tracking, and drawing boxes around objects in video or photos, so a developer doesn't have to write that computer-vision code from scratch.
buyer: A systems integrator building a camera-based product (retail analytics, safety monitoring, agriculture) for a client who needs object detection wired up quickly.
business_use_cases: An integrator builds a 'count cars in the lot' dashboard for a shopping-mall client using existing security cameras.
A farm-tech startup counts livestock or estimates crop yield from drone footage without a computer-vision team.
A retail-analytics firm tracks foot traffic and shelf stock levels from in-store cameras for chain retailers.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a vertical-specific computer-vision product (e.g. retail foot-traffic analytics) as a subscription
Charge for custom camera-integration projects for individual clients

steal_this: Build a 'count anything in your video feed' demo this weekend for one vertical, like retail foot traffic, and pitch it directly to a local business.
